families.name: Web Engineering
families.description: Websites, web applications, SaaS platforms, portals, and progressive web apps.

types.name: Mini Website / Landing Page
types.description: Focused marketing, documentation, or portfolio websites prioritizing fast loading, responsive layout, and SEO.

types.name: SaaS Web Application
types.description: Multi-tenant web application with authentication, role-based access control, billing, database persistence, and API integrations.

types.name: Enterprise Web Platform
types.description: Large-scale web systems with complex workflows, audit trails, compliance boundaries, and multi-region deployment.

families.name: Mobile Engineering
families.description: Native and cross-platform mobile software for Android, iOS, tablets, and wearables.

types.name: Native Android Application
types.description: Kotlin/Java Android applications leveraging Android SDK, Jetpack Compose, background services, and Play Store release pipelines.

types.name: Native iOS Application
types.description: Swift/SwiftUI iOS applications utilizing Apple frameworks, CoreData/SwiftData, push notifications, and App Store guidelines.

types.name: Cross-Platform Mobile App (Flutter / React Native)
types.description: Unified codebase targeting Android and iOS with native bridging, shared state, and responsive touch interfaces.

families.name: Desktop Engineering
families.description: Operating system desktop software for Windows, macOS, and Linux using Electron, Tauri, or native toolkits.

types.name: Cross-Platform Desktop (Tauri / Electron)
types.description: Desktop application with native OS integration, local file access, system tray, window management, and secure auto-updates.

types.name: Native Desktop System Tool
types.description: C++, Rust, or C# high-performance desktop application with direct hardware acceleration and OS-level API integration.

families.name: AI Engineering
families.description: Generative AI systems, LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic tool use, and multimodal pipelines.

types.name: RAG Knowledge & Retrieval System
types.description: Document ingestion, vector embeddings, semantic search, re-ranking, and grounded generation with citation verification.

types.name: Autonomous Agent & Multi-Agent System
types.description: Deterministic tool calling, task decomposition, agent collaboration, reflection, and safety guardrails.

families.name: Machine Learning Engineering
families.description: Predictive modeling, deep learning, computer vision, NLP, model training, evaluation, and MLOps deployment.

types.name: Classical ML & Tabular Predictive Pipeline
types.description: Supervised/unsupervised learning on structured data with feature engineering, cross-validation, and leak prevention.

types.name: Deep Learning / Vision / Audio Model
types.description: Neural network architectures, fine-tuning, tensor optimization, GPU acceleration, and latency-budgeted inference serving.

families.name: Data Engineering & Data Science
families.description: Data ingestion pipelines, lakehouses, analytics, statistical hypothesis testing, and business intelligence.

types.name: Data Ingestion & ETL/ELT Pipeline
types.description: Batch and streaming data pipelines with schema validation, idempotent retries, dead-letter queues, and data lineage.

types.name: Data Science & Statistical Analysis
types.description: Exploratory data analysis, statistical testing, reproducible notebooks, hypothesis evaluation, and visualization reporting.

families.name: Backend & Distributed Systems
families.description: High-throughput APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and distributed systems.

types.name: Distributed Microservices Architecture
types.description: Services communicating via gRPC/REST/messaging with circuit breakers, distributed tracing, and service discovery.

types.name: Event-Driven & Real-Time System
types.description: Kafka/RabbitMQ streaming engines with partition ordering, replayability, schema evolution, and WebSocket broadcast.

families.name: Operating Systems & Systems Engineering
families.description: Linux distributions, kernel modules, device drivers, bootloaders, filesystems, and low-level runtime engines.

types.name: Custom Linux Distribution / Appliance
types.description: Target kernel, initramfs, rootfs assembly, bootloader configuration, package repository, and bootable ISO generation.

types.name: Kernel Module & Device Driver
types.description: Low-level kernel space drivers with memory-mapped I/O, interrupt handling, concurrency synchronization, and crash prevention.

families.name: Embedded Systems, Firmware & Robotics
families.description: Microcontroller firmware, real-time operating systems (RTOS), IoT sensor hubs, and robotics control loops.

types.name: RTOS Microcontroller Firmware
types.description: Bare-metal or FreeRTOS/Zephyr firmware with strict memory bounds, peripheral drivers (SPI/I2C/UART), and watchdog safety.

types.name: Robotics Control & Edge Platform
types.description: ROS 2 nodes, sensor fusion, motor control loops, real-time state machines, and fail-safe safety interlocks.

families.name: Game & Simulation Engineering
families.description: Interactive graphics, 2D/3D games, physics engines, and numerical simulations.

types.name: Interactive 2D/3D Game Application
types.description: Game loop, entity-component systems, asset pipelines, physics simulation, spatial audio, and input handling.

families.name: Developer Tools, CLI & Compilers
families.description: CLI utilities, developer SDKs, compilers, domain-specific languages, and IDE extensions.

types.name: Command-Line Interface (CLI) Tool
types.description: Terminal utilities with subcommands, structured stdout/stderr, exit code semantics, and cross-platform binary builds.

types.name: Compiler, Interpreter & Language Toolchain
types.description: Lexer, AST parser, type checker, intermediate representation, code generator, and optimization passes.

families.name: Research & Scientific Software
families.description: Computational physics, numerical algorithms, bioinformatics, and reproducible scientific workflows.

types.name: Scientific Computing & Simulation Model
types.description: Numerical integration, differential equations, high-precision floating point validation, and scientific dataset exports.
